title: aspidium mexicanum
intro: Aspidium mexicanum, commonly known as Mexican polypody, is a species of fern native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions. The therapeutic actions of Mexican polypody include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
